rationale: Despite gapping up on positive earnings news, GMRS immediately sold off from its $12.01 open down to $10.23, breaking well below prior day's low ($11.04), session VWAP ($11.01), and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($10.74). However, initiating a short at $10.44 near the bottom of the intraday range (11.5%) after a 13% decline carries poor reward-to-risk, while going long fights dominant selling pressure and a wide 57.5 bps spread. Therefore, skipping is optimal until price either retests the $10.74-$11.01 resistance zone or establishes a firmer base.
